reviews.critique: The input is a coherent dictated message with recoverable punctuation, paragraph, quotation, and numbered-list cues. The output appropriately applies those cues without lexical paraphrasing or material omissions. Across all paragraphs, it preserves the names, entry counts, dates, access restrictions, review-only instruction, conditional Thursday reader procedures, pending repair status, quoted label, response deadline, and report-dependent final check. Capitalization, date formatting, and punctuation are appropriate for /transcribe.

The input is a coherent, plausible dictated operational message with recoverable intent and no authoring-instruction leakage or artificial noise.
